book.titleProper: Die Union Choral Harmonie / The Union Choral Harmony

internalNote: Built from Kevin's own per-song extraction CSV (UCH1839_complete_271_tunes.csv), 271 songs, pages 1-192 - the tenth edition, with additions and improvements, of Henry C. Eyer's bilingual German/English tunebook. Stereotyped by John Fagan, Philadelphia; copyright entered 1839 by Eyer in the clerk's office of the eastern district of Pennsylvania - confirmed directly from the title and copyright pages. No explicit publisher statement appears anywhere in the supplied pages (only the stereotyper), so publisher is left unset here and on the Library's own edition record rather than guessed. Kevin confirmed directly that page 192 is the true end of the book; earlier drafts of this extraction's own tracking record (an uploaded extraction-state snapshot) had marked the book incomplete at page 170, before the remaining pages were supplied - that snapshot is now superseded by this 271-song CSV. Real numbering irregularities in the book's own printed catalog numbers are preserved as printed, not corrected: Funeral Thought and Eternity both carry No. 53; Contemplation (p.42) duplicates Friendship's own No. 76; no tune carries No. 74 at all; Clifford (No. 148) and Pebmarsh (No. 145) appear out of sequence; David's Lamentation/Come Ye Disconsolate both carry No. 206, and Claremont/New York both carry No. 208. Two visual/layout notes from the extraction are preserved in the data itself: page 24 places Mahony (No. 37) above Calvary (No. 36), and page 57's own upper portion concludes the prior tune (Transport) rather than starting a new one, so Exhortation is keyed to 57 despite not beginning at the top of the page. The extraction's own reconciliation of the book's German first-line and English tune-title indexes against these final tune pages has not been separately confirmed; this is a first-pass build from the completed extraction CSV alone.
